title: Top-Down Movement
description: Build an 8-directional top-down character controller with normalized diagonal speed, sprinting, mouse aiming, and directional animations.

blocks.content: The [Top-Down Controller](node_library/helper_tool#node-topDownController) node handles 8-directional movement on the X and Y axes with diagonal speed normalization and sprint multipliers. Connect its outputs to [Top-Down Animator](node_library/helper_tool#node-topDownAnimator) to drive 4-way, 8-way, or angle-rotated character sprites.

items.title: 8-Way Movement
items.desc: Smooth horizontal, vertical, and diagonal movement with automatic normalization.

items.title: Sprint Support
items.desc: Hold **Shift** (or any mapped sprint key) to multiply movement speed and fire **onSprint**.

items.title: Mouse Aiming
items.desc: Turn on **faceMouse** to calculate facing angle and direction toward the cursor.

blocks.content: Configure your character [entity](components/entities_and_prefabs) for zero-gravity 2D movement on the X and Y plane.

rows: Set **Motion Mode** to **Top-Down** and **Linear Drag** to **5.00** or higher so the character stops crisply (gravity is automatically 0).
Attach a **Solid (Physics)** box or circle collider positioned around the character's feet or torso.
Create directional clips (such as **idle_down**, **walk_down**, **walk_up**, **walk_side**) or single clips for rotation mode.
Attach to the character entity to run the top-down script.

blocks.content: Connect **Top-Down Controller** and **Top-Down Animator** in a visual script.

items: Select your character entity, check its **Physics Body** section in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), and set **Gravity Scale** to **0**.
Open your character script in the [visual scripting](visual_scripting/graph_concepts) editor and add an [On Tick](node_library/game_lifecycle#node-eventTick) node.

Add a [Top-Down Controller](node_library/helper_tool#node-topDownController) node and a [Top-Down Animator](node_library/helper_tool#node-topDownAnimator) node from [Helper & Tool](node_library/helper_tool).
Connect **execOut** on **On Tick** to **execIn** on **Top-Down Controller**, and **execOut** on **Top-Down Controller** to **execIn** on **Top-Down Animator**.
Wire **movementState**, **facingDirection**, and **facingAngle** from **Top-Down Controller** into the matching inputs on **Top-Down Animator**.
Select **Top-Down Animator**, choose your **Direction Mode** (**4-Way**, **8-Way**, or **Rotation**), enter your clip names, and click **Play** in the [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport).

blocks.content: Adjust these inputs on **Top-Down Controller** and **Top-Down Animator** in the **Parameters** section.

rows: Base walking speed in pixels per second.
Prevents diagonal movement from being 41 percent faster than cardinal movement.
When **True**, aims **facingDirection** and **facingAngle** toward the mouse cursor instead of the movement keys.
On **Top-Down Animator**, selects whether clips are chosen by 4 cardinal directions, 8 directions, or sprite rotation angle.
Automatically mirrors horizontal side animations when switching between **left** and **right**.

blocks.content: Customize the controller for twin-stick shooters, footsteps, or custom axis math.

rows: Set **faceMouse** to **True** on **Top-Down Controller** and set **directionMode** to **rotation** on **Top-Down Animator** so the character rotates toward the cursor while moving with **W**, **A**, **S**, and **D**.

Connect the **onMove** or **onSprint** execution output of **Top-Down Controller** to a [Cooldown](node_library/flow_logic#node-logicCooldown) node followed by [Play Audio](node_library/system_utilities#node-playAudio).

Combine [Calculate Axis 2D](node_library/input_controls#node-calculateAxis2d), [Set Face Direction](node_library/game_physics#node-setFaceDirection), and [Move and Slide](node_library/game_physics#node-moveAndSlide) when you want custom acceleration formulas.
Character falls toward the bottom of the screen when the game starts
Set **Gravity Scale** to **0** in the character's **Physics Body** component.
Character moves faster diagonally than horizontally
Set **normalizeDiagonal** to **True** on the **Top-Down Controller** node.
Character collider blocks doorways that look wide enough
Reduce the **Size (px)** of the character's **Solid (Physics)** collider so it covers only the lower half (feet) of the sprite.
